First Nations Bank of Canada has announced a $15-million investment by the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation, The Canadian Press reports.

The remains of a soldier killed in a grass fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta last month have returned to British Columbia, with dozens of police officers, firefighters and others gathering to pay their respects, The Canadian Press reports.

Voters delivered a sweeping rebuke of President Trump and his party in the midterms, handing Democrats major victories and dramatically reshaping the balance of power in Washington, PBS NewsHour reports.
Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in prison in national security case, The Guardian reports.
